title: OpsKit member manifest (.opskit/pack.yml)
description: The contract a supportive project declares so OpsKit can drive and develop it as a subagent. Lives at .opskit/pack.yml in the member's own repo. Versioned via `contract`: bump it (and this schema) together, so a stale member fails validation instead of drifting silently.

contract.description: Manifest contract version this file targets. Must match the version this schema describes.

name.description: Member name (lowercase + hyphens). Becomes projects/<name>/ when mounted.

description.description: One line: what this member contributes as a subagent.

data_classification.description: Sensitivity of the member's OWN tracked content. Gates what OpsKit's publication guard permits when the member is mounted.

sync.description: How OpsKit obtains the member: clone a git remote, or symlink a local checkout (local development).

url.description: Git URL (sync=clone). Optional here — it may live only in OpsKit's gitignored .project-remotes when the URL is itself sensitive.

pin.description: Commit SHA or tag to pin the mount to (sync=clone).

agents.description: Subagent definitions this member contributes (member-relative paths to agents/*.md files).

path.description: Member-relative path to an agent .md file.

skills.description: Skills this member contributes (member-relative paths to skill directories containing SKILL.md).

path.description: Member-relative path to a skill directory.

docs.description: Methodology docs a mounting subagent may read at runtime (member-relative paths).

config_fragment.description: Optional member-relative path to a harness config fragment (e.g. a permission overlay).

context_generators.description: Optional member-relative paths to scripts that render env-local fact sheets into environments/<env>/context/.

trust.description: Sandbox defaults OpsKit applies when mounting this member's subagent(s).

bash.description: Default bash permission for the mounted subagent.

tool_deny.description: Tool globs the mounted subagent must be denied (e.g. mikromcp_*).
